name: Maheshwari Logistics Limited
about: Maheshwari Logistics Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides logistics services in India. The company operates through four segments: Trade Division, Coal Division, Paper Division, and Waste Division. It is involved in trading and import of coal; dealing in petcoke and diesel; supplying non-cooking coal; collecting wastepaper products; manufacturing of recycled kraft paper; and trading and exports of various papers. The company also operates a coal screening plant in Vapi, Gujarat, as well as owns trucks. It serves cement, paper, textiles, and fertilizers industries. Maheshwari Logistics Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vapi, India.
